requirement: brief: add a control baseline (random picks; favourites only) to every leaderboard run (readiness PR-17)
price_rule: observed prices only (American odds -> decimal); no -110 fill

controls.name: random side (analytic)
controls.method: for each priced game the expected profit of a uniformly random side is 0.25*(dec_away + dec_home) - 1; the reported value is the mean over the frozen corpus (no RNG, fully deterministic)
controls.role: no-skill reference line for every board run

source.t: results + prices: nfl.com schedules index (official) via the pinned feed

controls.name: random side over/under (analytic)
controls.method: same as CTRL-01 on over/under prices

source.t: results + prices: nfl.com schedules index (official) via the pinned feed

controls.name: favourites only
controls.method: bet the favourite every priced frozen game at its observed spread price; side = home iff spread_line > 0; push excluded from ROI
controls.role: the market's own default bet; a strategy must beat this before it beats anything

source.t: results + prices: nfl.com schedules index (official) via the pinned feed

prospective_rule: every future board run must publish CTRL-01/CTRL-02 computed on the same settled set as the strategies it ranks; a strategy whose interval overlaps the control interval is not distinguishable from no skill
note: the favourites-only control loses at observed prices in this corpus; that is the vig the strategy must first overcome, and it is why raw win rate cannot rank strategies
